name: Evocation Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Chromatic Orb; Shatter; Fireball; Vitriolic Sphere; Wall of Force. Once per turn, when an Evocation spell you cast deals damage, roll and spend up to two unused Hit Dice and add them to one damage roll.
